mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 700K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 700K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals decreased economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive trend in real disposable income (RSAFS) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a shift towards inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8% signals a weakening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal: during early-cycle expansions, a positive GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2% drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window in early-cycle expansions, or 60-day forward returns in these periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
